transformers.note: Ran under 4.57.6 in practice; the model card's requirement has not been transcribed. Grade it before release.

resources._note: One card per worker on 96 GB hardware. The two-card rule was measured on 80 GB cards, where 58 GiB of MoE weights left ~22 GiB for vision activations that peaked at ~17 GiB, and 11% of stress calls failed asking for ~6 GiB more. The same 58 GiB on a 96 GB card leaves ~38 GiB, more than twice the measured peak. The dense 32B already ran on one card at 80 GB; it is the MoE's activation profile, not its weights, that needed the second card. Not re-measured against this model directly - if it OOMs, put this back to 2.
